Thanks for the questions, Ellie — great ones. Short answers and actions below.

1) VPC vs VPN: start with VPN + sample dataset for Week0 to validate core flows (API auth, sample throughput). If you hit network-bound latency issues or want isolation for production-like tests, we recommend moving to VPC peering for Week1. I'll flag both options in the MAP so you can pick the path that matches your procurement cadence.

2) Data governance checklist: added a one-page PII mapping and retention checklist to the doc (Tab: Data & Compliance). It lists fields we typically surface and the retention options Redwood supports (default 30 days, configurable).

3) Kickoff attendees: your platform lead + one engineer is perfect for the first 30-min. For the follow-up technical deep-dive (Week0+), recommend adding your infra lead plus an SRE or security contact.

I've updated the shared GDoc with example acceptance gates (smoke test, 1k token throughput, example prompts) and added owners for each line item. Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3C_MAP_template_v1
Attachments: MAP_template_v1.gdoc (updated)

Can you confirm:
- Preferred kickoff window on Tue 6/9 between 10:00–12:00 PDT or Wed 6/10 14:00–16:00 PDT?
- Who should be the doc owner on NovaCorp's side (Ellie or Samir)?

I'll schedule the 30-min slot once you confirm and will include a short acceptance checklist as a GSheet for tracking.
